# Unit Transaction Report

```{r,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(openxlsx)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

# Load and clean data once
df <- read.xlsx("E:\\narration\\vinay sir files\\unit_transactions_1750066298503.xlsx") %>%
  filter(OUTLIER == "No") %>%
  mutate(
    VALUE = as.numeric(`VALUE.(SAR)`),
    AREA = as.numeric(`UNIT.AREA.(sqm)`),
    RATE = as.numeric(`TRANSACTION.RATE.(SAR/sqm)`),
    DATE = as.Date(`TRANSACTION.DATE`),
    NEIGHBORHOOD = str_to_title(NEIGHBORHOOD),
    ZONE = str_to_title(ZONE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE), !is.na(AREA), !is.na(RATE), !is.na(DATE), !is.na(NEIGHBORHOOD), !is.na(ZONE))

#--------------- Point 1: High-Value Transactions
# Get top 2 high-value transactions
top_tx_hv <- df %>% arrange(desc(VALUE)) %>% slice(1:2)

# Format values for sentence
hv_n1 <- top_tx_hv$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
hv_a1 <- paste0(formatC(top_tx_hv$AREA[1], format = "f", digits = 0), " sqm")
hv_v1 <- dollar(top_tx_hv$VALUE[1], prefix = "SAR ", big.mark = ",", largest_with_cents = Inf)
hv_r1 <- formatC(top_tx_hv$RATE[1], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
hv_d1 <- format(top_tx_hv$DATE[1], "%B %d, %Y")

hv_n2 <- top_tx_hv$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
hv_a2 <- paste0(formatC(top_tx_hv$AREA[2], format = "f", digits = 0), " sqm")
hv_v2 <- dollar(top_tx_hv$VALUE[2], prefix = "SAR ", big.mark = ",", largest_with_cents = Inf)
hv_r2 <- formatC(top_tx_hv$RATE[2], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
hv_d2 <- format(top_tx_hv$DATE[2], "%B %d, %Y")

#--------------- Point 2: Premium Pricing by Neighborhood
# Average rate per neighborhood
rate_by_neigh_p <- df %>%
  group_by(NEIGHBORHOOD) %>%
  summarise(avg_rate = mean(RATE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_rate))

# Top 3 premium neighborhoods
top3_p <- rate_by_neigh_p %>% slice(1:3)
# One affordable neighborhood
low1_p <- rate_by_neigh_p %>% slice_tail(n = 1)

# Format values (round to nearest hundred)
p_n1 <- top3_p$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
p_r1 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top3_p$avg_rate[1], -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
p_n2 <- top3_p$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
p_r2 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top3_p$avg_rate[2], -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
p_n3 <- top3_p$NEIGHBORHOOD[3]
p_r3 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top3_p$avg_rate[3], -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
p_nl <- low1_p$NEIGHBORHOOD
p_rl <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(low1_p$avg_rate, -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))

#--------------- Point 3: High-Demand Neighborhoods
# Count transactions per neighborhood
txn_counts_d <- df %>%
  group_by(NEIGHBORHOOD) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(count))

# Get top 3 neighborhoods
top3_d <- txn_counts_d %>% slice(1:3)

# Extract values and round counts
d_n1 <- top3_d$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
d_c1 <- round(top3_d$count[1], -1)  # nearest 10
d_n2 <- top3_d$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
d_c2 <- round(top3_d$count[2], -1)
d_n3 <- top3_d$NEIGHBORHOOD[3]
d_c3 <- round(top3_d$count[3], -1)

#--------------- Point 4: Property Type Trends
# Function to get zone-level summary - returns NULL if any NA values
get_zone_summary_clean <- function(zone_name) {
  zone_df <- df %>% filter(ZONE == zone_name)
  
  # Return NULL if no data or any NA rates
  if (nrow(zone_df) == 0 || any(is.na(zone_df$RATE))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get top neighborhood by count
  top_neigh <- zone_df %>%
    group_by(NEIGHBORHOOD) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), avg_rate = mean(RATE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(NEIGHBORHOOD)
  
  # Calculate stats
  stats <- zone_df %>%
    filter(NEIGHBORHOOD == top_neigh) %>%
    summarise(
      min_rate = min(RATE),
      max_rate = max(RATE),
      avg_rate = mean(RATE)
    )
  
  list(
    neighborhood = top_neigh,
    min_rate = round(stats$min_rate),
    max_rate = round(stats$max_rate),
    avg_rate = round(stats$avg_rate)
  )
}

# Generate report text only for zones with complete data
generate_property_trends_text <- function() {
  trends_text <- "4. Property Type Trends\n\n"
  
  # Check each property type
  res_building <- get_zone_summary_clean("Residential Building")
  villa <- get_zone_summary_clean("Single Family Villa")
  commercial <- get_zone_summary_clean("Commercial")
  
  if (!is.null(res_building)) {
    trends_text <- paste0(trends_text, 
                         "Residential buildings in ", res_building$neighborhood, 
                         ", priced between SAR ", res_building$min_rate, 
                         " to SAR ", res_building$max_rate, " per sqm, attract upscale buyers.\n")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(villa)) {
    trends_text <- paste0(trends_text, 
                         "Al Aziziyah villas, ranging from SAR ", villa$min_rate, 
                         " to SAR ", villa$max_rate, " per sqm, appeal to family buyers.\n")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(commercial)) {
    trends_text <- paste0(trends_text, 
                         "Commercial properties in ", commercial$neighborhood, 
                         ", averaging SAR ", commercial$avg_rate, " per sqm, attract investors.")
  }
  
  # If all are NULL
  if (trends_text == "4. Property Type Trends\n\n") {
    return("4. Property Type Trends\n\nNo complete data available for any property type.")
  }
  
  return(trends_text)
}
# Get all summaries
res_building <- get_zone_summary_clean("Residential Building")
villa <- get_zone_summary_clean("Single Family Villa") 
commercial <- get_zone_summary_clean("Commercial")

# Use this to generate your report text
property_trends_text <- generate_property_trends_text()


#--------------- Point 5: Pricing Segmentation
# Get max/min rate by neighborhood
rate_by_neigh_s <- df %>%
  group_by(NEIGHBORHOOD) %>%
  summarise(
    max_rate = max(RATE, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rate = min(RATE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_rate))

# Get top 2 luxury and 2 affordable neighborhoods
luxury_s <- rate_by_neigh_s %>% slice(1:2)
affordable_s <- rate_by_neigh_s %>% arrange(max_rate) %>% slice(1:2)

# Format values
s_lux1 <- luxury_s$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
s_lux2 <- luxury_s$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
s_lux_max <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(max(luxury_s$max_rate), -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
s_aff1 <- affordable_s$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
s_aff2 <- affordable_s$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
s_aff_min <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(min(affordable_s$min_rate), -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
s_aff_max <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(max(affordable_s$max_rate), -2), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))

#--------------- Point 6: Largest Plot Deals
# Get top 2 largest unit area transactions
top_large_plots_l <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(AREA)) %>%
  slice(1:2)

# Extract and format data
l_n1 <- top_large_plots_l$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
l_v1 <- dollar(top_large_plots_l$VALUE[1], prefix = "SAR ", big.mark = ",", largest_with_cents = Inf)
l_a1 <- paste0(formatC(top_large_plots_l$AREA[1], format = "f", digits = 0), " sqm")
l_r1 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top_large_plots_l$RATE[1], 0), big.mark = ","))
l_d1 <- format(top_large_plots_l$DATE[1], "%B %d, %Y")

l_n2 <- top_large_plots_l$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
l_v2 <- dollar(top_large_plots_l$VALUE[2], prefix = "SAR ", big.mark = ",", largest_with_cents = Inf)
l_a2 <- paste0(formatC(top_large_plots_l$AREA[2], format = "f", digits = 0), " sqm")
l_r2 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top_large_plots_l$RATE[2], 0), big.mark = ","))
l_d2 <- format(top_large_plots_l$DATE[2], "%B %d, %Y")

#--------------- Point 7: Top Land Transactions by Value
# Top 2 transactions by value
top_tx_t <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(VALUE)) %>%
  slice(1:2)

# Extract and format first transaction
t_n1 <- top_tx_t$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
t_d1 <- format(top_tx_t$DATE[1], "%B %d, %Y")
t_v1 <- dollar(top_tx_t$VALUE[1], prefix = "SAR ", big.mark = ",", largest_with_cents = Inf)
t_a1 <- paste0(formatC(top_tx_t$AREA[1], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " sqm")
t_r1 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top_tx_t$RATE[1], 0), format = "f", big.mark = ","))

# Extract and format second transaction
t_n2 <- top_tx_t$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
t_d2 <- format(top_tx_t$DATE[2], "%B %d, %Y")
t_v2 <- dollar(top_tx_t$VALUE[2], prefix = "SAR ", big.mark = ",", largest_with_cents = Inf)
t_a2 <- paste0(formatC(top_tx_t$AREA[2], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " sqm")
t_r2 <- paste0("SAR ", formatC(round(top_tx_t$RATE[2], 0), format = "f", big.mark = ","))
```
